lines.text: The house across from mine has been empty for ten years.
But every night at three A M, a light turns on in the top window.
A tall shadow stands there. And waves.
At first, I waved back. It felt polite.
Then I noticed it was getting closer to the glass. Every night, a little closer.
Last night, it stopped waving. It lifted one long arm, and pointed. Not at me. Behind me.
I turned around slowly. My bedroom door was open. I always close it.
Then the light across the street went out. And the light in my hallway... turned on.
